body: CHANGELOG updated in shankpit-460: fix(ci): PLAY.bat now invokes ShankPit.exe directly + ends with pause, matching REDGARDEN's own proven PLAY.bat exactly, instead of 'start ShankPit.exe' (opens a detached window with zero error visibility and no pause -- if anything else ever goes wrong, e.g. a missing DLL or a crash, the player would see nothing at all, indistinguishable from 'stuck'). Same commit as the ticket-secret fix's own follow-up hardening. (sess-20260809-1420-e9d3d7f8)
